What a project manager sees.

One register across the job

Open, issued, in-review and closed items in a single list you can filter by trade, level or status — no chasing five spreadsheets.

Where closeout actually stands

See how many items are still open, how long they have been sitting, and which trades are holding things up — before the client asks.

A record you can stand behind

Each closed item carries its photo and history, so the handover pack and any later DLP query are straightforward to answer.

What you stop doing.

Rebuilding the defect list from messages and emails the week before PC
Asking the site manager “what’s the real number?” and getting a different answer each time
Finding out a trade went quiet on an item only when it shows up at handover
Hunting for the photo that proves an item was fixed when a claim lands months later
